user_acceptance.value_boundary: Emitted directly as a 0.0-1.0 float score.

ranking_override.value_boundary: Internally a metadata bool (GenerationTelemetry.ranking_override, telemetry.py:227); converted to 1.0/0.0 float only at the Opik boundary by ranking_override_feedback_score (telemetry.py:291). Never store the raw bool as a score value.

contract_consistent.value_boundary: 1.0 when no contract violation, else 0.0 (Issue #204 Slice 5.5).

human.craft_rating.value_boundary: Harness convention 1-5; human_review_v1 leaves craft_rating an unconstrained number (drift-guard / workspace FD enforces the scale, not the schema).

human.gold_dispute.value_boundary: Harness convention disputed/not_disputed; human_review_v1 leaves gold_dispute a plain boolean (no enum).

human.regime_label.value_boundary: The only schema-enforced FD scale: human_review_v1 pins enum ['A','B','unknown'].

notes: human.notes_present is derived/read-only metadata (notes is a top-level free-text string in human_review_v1 with scores.additionalProperties=false); it is never minted as a workspace Feedback Definition and is excluded from the drift guard. final_accept is an artifact_class/provenance_label binding-identity enum value (a provenance tag), not a review-outcome score, and is excluded from the Tier-1 FD vocabulary. Scales are harness conventions enforced by the drift-guard test and the Opik workspace FDs, not by human_review_v1.
